claimed and make approximation, incompleteness,"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" or uncertainty explicit."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**Jacobian's hypothesis is that mathematical reasoning benefits from an

instead of baking one proof strategy or workflow into the tools themselves."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"See Executable mathematical vocabulary
